page_title: FRA 2-0 MOR | France v Morocco 09/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Michael Olise (France) controls a great pass from Bradley Barcola on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
90+5' Wasted effort! Gessime Yassine (Morocco) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
90+4' Great save! Jean-Philippe Mateta (France) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Bono.
90+3' Handball by Amine Sbai (Morocco).
90+3' Jean-Philippe Mateta loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Adrien Rabiot (France).
90+2' Gessime Yassine (Morocco) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
90+2' The resulting corner from Amine Sbai (Morocco) comes to nothing.
90+2' An attempted cross from Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) is cleared. Morocco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:4. 10:9 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
88' Ousmane Dembele bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (France) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
88' Ousmane Dembele (France) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

88' Bradley Barcola (France) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Bono, who tips the ball around the post. It will be a corner kick for France.
87' Didier Deschamps has decided to substitute Jules Kounde and he is replaced by Malo Gusto (France).
86' Michael Olise (France) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
86' Amine Sbai (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Substitution. Chemsdine Talbi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Amine Sbai (Morocco).
84' Achraf Hakimi sends over an inswinging corner and Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just wide of the left post.
84' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is about to take a corner kick.

83' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass. Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mike Maignan makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
83' Adrien Rabiot (France) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Facundo Tello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Morocco.
82' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
82' Jules Kounde (France) trips an opposition player and Facundo Tello signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Morocco.
81' A cross into the box from Gessime Yassine (Morocco) is cleared.
80' Ousmane Dembele (France) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
80' Bradley Barcola (France) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Corner kick. France will have an opportunity.
78' Warren Zaire-Emery (France) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
78' The attendance is 63811.
77' Didier Deschamps decides to make a substitution. Desire Doue will be replaced by Bradley Barcola (France).
77' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Kylian Mbappe (France) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Philippe Mateta.
77' Kylian Mbappe (France) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 17:2. The number of shots on goal at present is 6:0.
74' Mohamed Ouahbi prepares a substitution. Anass Salah-Eddine is replaced by Zakaria El Ouahdi (Morocco).
74' Substitution. Gessime Yassine (Morocco) in, Brahim Diaz out.
73' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
73' Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Morocco earn a corner.
71' The match can continue after the interruption.
71' Substitution. Manu Kone makes his way off the pitch and Warren Zaire-Emery (France) comes on as his replacement.
68' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

66' 2 - 0 Goal! Kylian Mbappe sets up Ousmane Dembele (France) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
65' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The linesman signals a throw-in for France.

64' Adrien Rabiot (France) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
63' Issa Diop (Morocco) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card. Issa Diop (Morocco) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
62' Mohamed Ouahbi has decided to make a change. Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
62' Ayyoub Bouaddi goes off the pitch and Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) comes on.
60' 1 - 0 Kylian Mbappe (France) struck from medium range. He buried the ball inside the right post.
60' Adrien Rabiot (France) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
58' Kylian Mbappe (France) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
56' CHANCE! Kylian Mbappe (France) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
55' Desire Doue (France) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Bono.

55' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Facundo Tello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
53' Desire Doue (France) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
52' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
52' Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Morocco force their opponents to concede a corner.

49' Adrien Rabiot almost found himself in a promising position after Michael Olise (France) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
49' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) tries to find Chemsdine Talbi, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
48' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
47' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.

45+4' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Adrien Rabiot (France) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45+4' Ousmane Dembele (France) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' Crossbar! Lucas Digne (France) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
45+1' Manu Kone (France) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
45+1' Bono is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Michael Olise (France). Easy save!
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Dayot Upamecano (France) tries to find Jules Kounde, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
42' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
42' Dayot Upamecano (France) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Morocco will take a free kick near the side line.
40' The Morocco players are exchanging some short passes.

38' Facundo Tello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) brought his opponent down. France win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' A pass by Michael Olise (France) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' Michael Olise floats over the corner and Jules Kounde (France) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
36' Michael Olise (France) will deliver the corner kick.

35' Desire Doue (France) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Bono makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. The ball is out of play. France will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) sprays a pass out to Brahim Diaz, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
34' The total number of attempts is 8:0. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
33' Ousmane Dembele (France) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
32' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
29' The referee blows for a cooling break.
28' Bono anticipates the direction of the penalty by Kylian Mbappe (France). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
28' Kylian Mbappe (France) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
28' Referee Facundo Tello is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to France!
26' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to France using VAR. Let's see what happens.

25' A clumsy foul by Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) and Facundo Tello blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to France after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
25' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Ayyoub Bouaddi, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
24' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
24' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) plays a one-two with Azzedine Ounahi, but the move breaks down. Now Morocco have a corner.
23' The ball is cleared after Ousmane Dembele (France) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

22' Michael Olise (France) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.
21' The corner kick picks out Adrien Rabiot (France) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
21' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner with a short pass.

20' Jules Kounde (France) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. France will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Ousmane Dembele (France) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Desire Doue floats in a cross for Ousmane Dembele (France), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 54:46.

16' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
15' Poor challenge! Lucas Digne (France) is penalised for tripping and Facundo Tello blows his whistle. Morocco have a free kick.
15' Desire Doue (France) sends a precise pass into the box, but Kylian Mbappe loses the one-on-one with the defender.
14' The free kick is delivered by Michael Olise (France) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
14' Facundo Tello blows his whistle after Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to France in a dangerous position.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lucas Digne (France).
12' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Some great controlled play and passing from France. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Desire Doue (France) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
9' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) sends a long ball forward to Achraf Hakimi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
9' Desire Doue (France) brings his opponent down. Facundo Tello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Morocco.
4' A brilliant cross into the box finds Dayot Upamecano (France), who steers his low header towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
4' Ousmane Dembele (France) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

4' A neat pass finds Kylian Mbappe (France) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Bono denies him with a good save. The ball goes out of play and France have been awarded a corner kick.
3' The France players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Morocco will kick the game off.
Facundo Tello will supervise the game today.
